rationale: Observe every exact frozen non-Builder launch-core asset at runtime at least once.
Preselect additional edge/adversarial coverage before seeing results.
Avoid turning a USD 9 bounded v1 launch into an unnecessarily exhaustive 87-chat qualification exercise.
Keep segmented-context and cross-model limitations explicit.

closure_rule: 32/32 PASS and no blocking failure. FAIL blocks the affected asset and gate. INCONCLUSIVE must be resolved or the affected asset removed from launch. A PASS establishes segmented exact-asset runtime evidence only; it does not establish independent-context robustness or cross-model portability.
